entities.summary: Jessie Andrews is an American actress, fashion designer, and model. Starting out as a pornographic film actress, she received an AVN Award for Best Actress for her performance in Portrait of a Call Girl (2011). More recently, she has appeared in mainstream film and television roles, including Hot Summer Nights (2017) and Euphoria (2022).
